caption: A shopping cart is pushed up to a clear glass door which swings open, the cart having been fully visible through it as it approached.

sa.check: A shopping cart is pushed up to a clear glass door.
The cart is fully visible through the door as it approaches.
The cart goes through the opening.
The door opens first and the cart passes after.

pc.expect: The cart is seen through the glass the whole way and the door opens on its hinges when pushed.
pc.fail: The glass hides the cart; or the door opens with nothing pushing it; or it stays shut while the cart passes.

pc.expect: The cart goes through the opening, not through the glass.
pc.fail: It passes through the pane; or the door passes through it; or the cart is inside the glass.

pc.expect: The door swings in an arc on its hinges.
pc.fail: It slides; or lifts; or spins.

pc.expect: The cart moves only as pushed.
pc.fail: It rolls by itself; or jumps; or stops dead with no obstacle.
The cart duplicates; or the door vanishes; or the cart turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cart and the doorway stay the same.
pc.fail: The cart changes colour; or the frame changes; or the shop rearranges.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
